Try a broader word. Need one that isn't here? Run python3 tools/icons.py add NAME (any name from lucide.dev).

Using icons

<svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>          <!-- 18px -->
<svg class="f-i f-i--sm"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>    <!-- 15px -->
<svg class="f-i f-i--lg"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>    <!-- 22px -->

Icons take the text colour (currentColor). Inline icons.svg once near the top of <body>. For production, python3 tools/icons.py subset index.html … prints a sprite with only the icons you use. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label; decorative icons next to text need nothing.
